phase: Phase 2: One state and one reason per card
summary: Phase 2 passes acceptance at ada02de. All four tasks have SHA evidence. The tsc run, the vitest run (25 files, 431 tests), and the bundle comparison pass. FR-9 to FR-17 and the five acceptance criteria hold in code, tests, and the UX evidence. One Major finding and three Nit findings stay nonblocking.
nonblocking_findings: F1 [Major] phase-acceptance: extensions/measure-status/README.md:95-100 omits FR-11 rule c. It says 'Each other open track gives Next in line'. A `[b]` task with a non-gate owner, a registry marker `[b]`, and a plan with all tasks closed give Waits for PM instead. The live board shows 31 such cards. Rationale: FR-17 requires the README to follow the new rules, and the README is the only plain statement of the state rules. No behavior is affected, so the finding does not block.

F2 [Nit] phase-acceptance: extensions/measure-status/src/board.ts:276 reads only the first line of the task text for rule a0, because src/parse.ts:150 stores only the first line. A verification row with the words 'deferred' or 'no visible change' only on a wrapped continuation line gives Waits for Daniel: look through rule R3a (board.ts:293), when the row is the current task and the age is 14 days or less. Acceptance criterion 5 fails for that shape. FR-11 a0 says 'text', so the spec is ambiguous. The read-only scan of the eight repos finds no such row: 60 open rows carry the words on the first line, 204 carry none, 0 carry them only on a continuation line. Rationale: the input class is the same class as the lending-desk-bench tag bug, and the PM check of the first real Waits for Daniel card covers a fault of this shape.

F3 [Nit] phase-acceptance: measure/tracks/board_focus_reasons_20261121/plan.md:27 writes 'Workbooks deps_refresh_20261121 D3 shows Waits for PM'. The live card shows 'Waits for PM: All tasks closed.' because the Workbooks plan closes the D3 row (PM-verified 2026-11-21). ux-browser-e410fd1.json states that the live run does not cover the open D3 row. Rationale: the open-row rule rests on src/card-state.test.ts:272-295 and on three live verification rows in ux-p2/all-open-cards.json, so the sentence should name that evidence.

F4 [Nit] phase-acceptance: measure/tracks/board_focus_reasons_20261121/plan.md:21 and plan.md:27 write counts (65 failing tests, 23 suites, 351 tests, 242 cards). skills/measure-orchestrator/SKILL.md:124 says to write no test count or check count in plan.md and to cite the log file. The counts are true (red-p2.log, ux-browser-e410fd1.json), so no A5 mismatch exists. Rationale: a pinned count drifts with the next change and starts a record-fix round.
